name: repo_bench_java-dataset
description: A collection of Java repository data intended for evaluating code-model performance on real-world Java code tasks such as generation, completion, and repair. The benchmark provides examples extracted from repositories to benchmark models' ability to produce correct Java code in context. Evaluation typically relies on correctness measures derived from compiled/output-matching or test-case based assessments.
reputation: A community-contributed Java code dataset hosted on Hugging Face; modest usage among code-model researchers and practitioners.
